pairs.l: 1 — I know it's a tough choice, but I can't wait any longer for your decision.
2 — You must think about the consequences. If you don't, you might hurt someone.
3 — Keep it to yourself. Nobody needs to know about it.
4 — Think twice before you resign; you might feel different in the morning.
5 — I'm really sorry, but this meeting is a must. No excuses this time.

r1.exp: Poruka 1 (teška odluka, ne mogu više čekati) = D (Make up your mind). Poruka 2 (misli na posljedice, možeš nekome nauditi) = A (Be responsible). Poruka 3 (zadrži za sebe, nitko ne treba znati) = E (Don't say anything). Poruka 4 (razmisli dvaput, ujutro ćeš se drugačije osjećati) = F (Sleep on it). Poruka 5 (sastanak je neizbježan, nema izgovora) = B (You can't avoid it).

r6.exp: 'You MUSTN'T LEAVE without visiting the Museum of Broken Relationships' — najjači naglasak (must not) = C (To the museum).

r7.exp: 'The others made fun of me and I just WANTED TO DISAPPEAR' = osjećaj srama = B (Ashamed). Strah je bio razlog, ali sram zbog ruganja je ključni osjećaj.

r8.exp: 'MY PARENTS WON'T LET ME' = nije mu dopušteno ići = A (He isn't allowed to go).

r9.exp: 'Willing to CARRY MY BOOKS and LEND ME THINGS' = spreman pomoći = B (He is helpful).

r10.exp: 'I'll do my best to FINISH IT IN TIME' = možda će stići = C (Maybe). Ne kaže ni da, ni ne.

r11.exp: 'AT 33, he's the most popular dog trainer' → trenutna dob je 33.

r12.exp: 'Back home in MEXICO' → Marcos je Meksikanac = Mexican.

r13.exp: 'He spoke only SPANISH' → materinji jezik je španjolski.

r14.exp: 'The FIRST JOB he took was as a LIMOUSINE DRIVER' → prvi posao bio je vozač limuzine.

r15.exp: 'The one he LIKES MOST' = Special Honor (jer je to bio njegov prvi nagrada).

r16.exp: 'Plans in great detail right (16)___, and THEN PANICS.' → A: when it is time to leave. Planira sve — pa kad dođe trenutak za polazak, paničari.

r17.exp: 'I can't understand (17)___. Perhaps it's because she hates waiting.' → F: why she is like this. Ne razumije ZAŠTO je takva.

r18.exp: 'Always ready and waiting (18)___. Then sits on suitcase and WATCHES everyone.' → C: until we have to go. Čeka strpljivo dok ne moramo krenuti.

r19.exp: 'I don't know (19)___. I could never be as ORGANIZED as she is.' → B: how she does it. Divi se sestri — ne zna kako to uspijeva biti tako organizirana.

r20.exp: 'I leave everything until last moment BUT always ready on time. Pack my bag (20)___.' → E: before it's too late. Pakira u zadnji čas — ali uvijek prije nego što bude prekasno.

r21.exp: 'Going to Europe ON business' — fiksna kolokacija: on business = poslovno.

r22.exp: 'Guarantee for THE loan' — određeni član 'the' jer se radi o specifičnom zajmu koji je već bio spominjan.

r23.exp: 'Which COMES to $19.67' — fiksna kolokacija: come to (a total of) = iznositi ukupno.

r24.exp: 'This transaction HAS worked out' — present perfect s jedninom (this transaction = jednina → has).

r25.exp: 'WHILE you were away' — 'while' za dvije radnje koje su se odvijale istovremeno (prošlo trajno).

r26.exp: 'Means table IN Latin' — prijedlog 'in' uz jezik: in Latin, in French, in English.

r27.exp: 'Forming A society' — neodređeni član 'a' uz jedninsku imenicu (prvi spomen).

r28.exp: 'The aim WAS... to create' — past simple jer govori o osnivanju organizacije 1946. (prošlost).

r29.exp: 'People... WHOSE IQ is in the top 2%' — posvojna relativna zamjenica 'whose' (čiji IQ).

r30.exp: 'Joined AT the age of two' — fiksni izraz: at the age of = s X godina.

sol.rubric: Odgovori na sva 3 pitanja: (1) kakav je žanr filma (komedija, triler, drama...), (2) o čemu govori film (kratki opis radnje), (3) jesi li volio/la i zašto (ili zašto ne). Dužina 40–60 riječi. Neformalan registar.

w1.exp: Pisani zadatak — nema jednog točnog odgovora. Ocjenjuju se sadržaj (odgovori na sva pitanja), jezik i dužina (40–60 riječi).
